title: A Lovable Eccentric
question: Why did the shop assistant refuse to serve Dickie?

meanings.meaning: 古怪的人；行为怪异的人
meanings.usage: 指行为偏离常规、特点鲜明的人，文中带有褒义，指可爱的怪人
用来描述行为、性格等不符合常规的
强调行为是有目的、刻意做出的
后常接规则、习俗、他人意见等名词，指故意不遵守或不重视
指社会普遍接受的行为准则或传统做法

meanings.meaning: 始终如一地；一贯地；总是
meanings.usage: 强调情况几乎没有例外，总是发生

meanings.meaning: 显要的；显著的；值得注意的
meanings.usage: 用来形容人或事物因特点突出而被大众知晓

meanings.meaning: 精明的；敏锐的；有判断力的
meanings.usage: 常用来形容人在商业、判断局势等方面头脑精明
形容人或事因极具特点而被广泛谈论，像传说一样有名

meanings.meaning: 势利小人；谄上欺下的人
meanings.usage: 指以地位、财富取人，看不起普通人的人
用来加强情绪、感受的程度
常形容人被雨淋湿后衣服脏乱、外表邋遢的状态
指上级对下属、长辈对晚辈的正式严厉批评
特指对艺术、文学、音乐等进行专业评论的人
形容计划、事件等经过了周密的安排和设计

phrases.usage: 表示“打算、着手做某事”，强调有明确的目的去做某件事

examples.en: True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves.
examples.zh: 真正的怪人从不刻意去吸引他人的注意。

examples.en: She set out to break the world record in the long jump.
examples.zh: 她立志要打破跳远的世界纪录。

phrases.usage: 表示“吸引对……的注意”，主语可以是人或事物

examples.en: The poster is designed to draw attention to the problem of global warming.
examples.zh: 这张海报旨在吸引人们关注全球变暖的问题。

examples.en: He tried not to draw attention to his mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 他尽量不让别人注意到他报告里的错误。

phrases.usage: 表示“给……增添趣味/色彩”，用比喻义表示让原本平淡的事物变得生动

examples.en: They add colour to the dull routine of everyday life.
examples.zh: 他们给平淡的日常生活增添了趣味。

examples.en: Her lively stories added colour to the boring meeting.
examples.zh: 她生动的故事给无聊的会议增添了乐趣。

phrases.usage: 表示“遭遇、陷入（坏天气、困境等）”，通常用于被动结构

examples.en: He walked into an expensive shop after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower.
examples.zh: 他遇上了一场特别大的阵雨，之后走进了一家高档商店。

examples.en: We were caught in a traffic jam on the way to the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在去机场的路上遇上了交通堵塞。

phrases.usage: 表示“不理会、不注意……”，后面接人或事物

examples.en: The assistant asked him to leave, but Dickie paid no attention to him and requested to see the manager.
examples.zh: 店员让他离开，但迪基理都不理他，要求见经理。

examples.en: Pay no attention to what others say about your choice.
examples.zh: 别理会别人对你的选择的议论。

phrases.usage: 表示“坚持要求、坚决主张”，后接名词或动词的-ing形式

examples.en: He insisted on the assistant's counting the money before he left.
examples.zh: 他坚持要店员数清楚钱再离开。

examples.en: My mother insists on walking for an hour after dinner every day.
examples.zh: 我妈妈坚持每天饭后散步一小时。

phrases.usage: 表示“大量的，许多的”，后接不可数名词

examples.en: This exhibition received a great deal of attention in the press.
examples.zh: 这次展览受到了媒体的大量关注。

examples.en: The project requires a great deal of time and effort to complete.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要投入大量的时间和精力才能完成。

phrases.usage: 表示“被认为；应该”，可以指人们普遍的看法，也可以指义务、规定

examples.en: Though the pictures were supposed to be the work of famous artists, they had in fact been painted by Dickie.
examples.zh: 虽然这些画被认为是著名艺术家的作品，但实际上都是迪基画的。

examples.en: You are supposed to arrive at the office before 9 o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 你应该每天早上九点之前到办公室。

sentences.en: True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves.
sentences.zh: 真正的怪人从不刻意引人注目。

sentences.en: They disregard social conventions without being conscious that they are doing anything extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 他们无视社会习俗，却没意识到自己在做任何非凡的事情。

sentences.en: This invariably wins them the love and respect of others, for they add colour to the dull routine of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 这总能让他们赢得他人的爱戴和尊重，因为他们为平淡的日常生活增添了色彩。

sentences.en: Up to the time of his death, Richard Colson was one of the most notable figures in our town.
sentences.zh: 直到去世，理查德·科尔森都是我们镇上最著名的人物之一。

sentences.en: He was a shrewd and wealthy businessman,
sentences.zh: 他是一位精明富有的商人，

sentences.en: but most people in the town hardly knew anything about this side of his life.
sentences.zh: 但镇上大多数人对他生活的这一面几乎一无所知。

sentences.en: He was known to us all as Dickie and his eccentricity had become legendary long before he died.
sentences.zh: 他被我们称为迪基，他的怪癖在他去世前很久就已成为传奇。

sentences.en: Dickie disliked snobs intensely.
sentences.zh: 迪基非常讨厌势利小人。

sentences.en: Though he owned a large car, he hardly ever used it, preferring always to go on foot.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有一辆大车，但他几乎从不用它，总是喜欢步行。

sentences.en: Even when it was raining heavily, he refused to carry an umbrella.
sentences.zh: 即使下大雨，他也不撑伞。

sentences.en: One day, he walked into an expensive shop after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower.
sentences.zh: 一天，他在一场大雨中淋湿后走进一家昂贵的商店。

sentences.en: He wanted to buy a ￡300 watch for his wife,
sentences.zh: 他想为妻子买一块300英镑的手表，

sentences.en: but he was in such a bedraggled condition that an assistant refused to serve him.
sentences.zh: 但他衣衫褴褛，店员拒绝为他服务。

sentences.en: Dickie left the shop without a word and returned carrying a large cloth bag.
sentences.zh: 迪基一言不发地离开了商店，然后提着一个大布袋回来了。

sentences.en: As it was extremely heavy, he dumped it on the counter.
sentences.zh: 因为袋子很重，他把它扔在柜台上。

sentences.en: The assistant asked him to leave, but Dickie paid no attention to him and requested to see the manager.
sentences.zh: 店员让他离开，但迪基没有理会他，要求见经理。

sentences.en: Recognizing who the customer was,
sentences.zh: 经理认出了这位顾客，

sentences.en: the manager was most apologetic and reprimanded the assistant severely.
sentences.zh: 非常抱歉，并严厉训斥了店员。

sentences.en: When Dickie was given the watch, he presented the assistant with the cloth bag.
sentences.zh: 当迪基拿到手表时，他把布袋递给了店员。

sentences.en: It contained ￡300 in pennies.
sentences.zh: 里面装着300英镑的便士。

sentences.en: He insisted on the assistant's counting the money before he left--30, 000 pennies in all!
sentences.zh: 他坚持要店员在他离开前数清钱——总共3万枚便士！

sentences.en: On another occasion, he invited a number of important critics to see his private collection of modern paintings.
sentences.zh: 另一次，他邀请了一些重要的评论家参观他的现代绘画私人收藏。

sentences.en: This exhibition received a great deal of attention in the press,
sentences.zh: 这次展览受到了媒体的广泛关注，

sentences.en: for though the pictures were supposed to be the work of famous artists,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管这些画被认为是著名艺术家的作品，

sentences.en: they had in fact been painted by Dickie.
sentences.zh: 但实际上它们是迪基画的。

sentences.en: It took him four years to stage this elaborate joke simply to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about.
sentences.zh: 他花了四年时间策划这个精心设计的玩笑，只是为了证明评论家并不总是知道他们在说什么。

exercises.prompt: “表示动作发生在主句动作之前，且与逻辑主语之间是被动关系，强调动作的完成和被动属性” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: having been + 过去分词，常在句中作时间、原因等状语
options: 间接引语（陈述句的转换）
现在分词的完成被动式
exercises.explain: 现在分词的完成被动式：having been + 过去分词，常在句中作时间、原因等状语：当从句的主语和主句主语一致，且从句动作先于主句动作发生、主语是动作的承受者时使用，可以替换相应的被动语态的状语从句

source.title: 现在分词的完成被动式

grammar.title: 现在分词的完成被动式
grammar.definition: 表示动作发生在主句动作之前，且与逻辑主语之间是被动关系，强调动作的完成和被动属性
grammar.structure: having been + 过去分词，常在句中作时间、原因等状语
grammar.usage: 当从句的主语和主句主语一致，且从句动作先于主句动作发生、主语是动作的承受者时使用，可以替换相应的被动语态的状语从句

examples.en: He walked into an expensive shop after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower.
examples.zh: 他遇上了一场特别大的阵雨，之后走进了一家高档商店。

examples.en: Having been told many times, he still couldn't understand the rule.
examples.zh: 已经被告知了很多次，他还是不懂这个规则。

grammar.title: for引导的原因状语从句
grammar.definition: 属于并列连词引导的状语从句，用来补充说明前一句话的原因或提供推断的理由，语气比because弱
grammar.structure: 主句 + for + 原因从句
grammar.usage: 通常不放在句首，而是放在主句之后，用逗号与主句隔开，是对前面内容的补充解释，而非直接的因果关系

examples.en: This invariably wins them the love and respect of others, for they add colour to the dull routine of everyday life.
examples.zh: 这总是能为他们赢得别人的喜爱和尊重，因为他们给平淡的日常生活增添了趣味。

examples.en: The days are short, for it is now December.
examples.zh: 白天很短，因为现在是十二月了。

grammar.title: though引导的让步状语从句
grammar.definition: 用来表示“虽然、尽管”，引导的从句与主句的内容存在转折关系，突出主句内容的合理性
grammar.structure: Though + 从句，主句 / 主句 + though + 从句
grammar.usage: 可以放在句首或句中，不能和but同时出现在同一个句子里，但可以和yet、still等词搭配

examples.en: Though he owned a large car, he hardly ever used it, preferring always to go on foot.
examples.zh: 虽然他有一辆大轿车，但他几乎从来不用，总喜欢步行。

examples.en: Though the task was very difficult, they managed to finish it on time.
examples.zh: 尽管任务非常困难，他们还是设法按时完成了。

original.en: He was known to us all as Dickie and his eccentricity had become legendary long before he died.
original.zh: 我们都叫他迪基，早在他去世之前，他的怪癖就已经传为美谈了。

examples.en: His songs had become popular long before he released his first album.
examples.zh: 早在他发行第一张专辑之前，他的歌就已经很受欢迎了。

examples.en: The small town's beautiful scenery had become famous long before it was developed as a tourist spot.
examples.zh: 早在这个小镇被开发成旅游景点之前，它的美景就已经很有名了。

patterns.pattern: He was in such a ... condition that ...

original.en: He wanted to buy a ￡300 watch for his wife, but he was in such a bedraggled condition that an assistant refused to serve him.
original.zh: 他想给妻子买一块价值300英镑的手表，但他当时浑身湿脏邋遢，店员拒绝为他服务。

examples.en: He was in such a tired condition that he fell asleep as soon as he got home.
examples.zh: 他太累了，一到家就睡着了。

examples.en: The old house was in such a dilapidated condition that no one wanted to rent it.
examples.zh: 这栋老房子破败不堪，没人愿意租。

patterns.pattern: It took sb + 时间 + to do sth simply to prove that ...

original.en: It took him four years to stage this elaborate joke simply to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about.
original.zh: 他花了四年时间策划这个精心的玩笑，只是为了证明评论家并不总是知道自己在说什么。

examples.en: It took her three months to prepare for the speech contest simply to prove that she could speak English as well as others.
examples.zh: 她花了三个月准备演讲比赛，只是为了证明她的英语能说得和别人一样好。

examples.en: It took the team half a year to complete the experiment simply to prove that their theory was correct.
examples.zh: 这个团队花了半年时间完成实验，只是为了证明他们的理论是正确的。
